title: Workflow
description: The states a record moves through and the steps that move it, with who may run each step and which steps need approval.

recordType.description: The record type that follows this workflow

role.description: Primary workflows hold the record's status; a parallel workflow runs beside it, for example case closure beside intake. Default primary

appliesWhen.description: Primary only: new records for which this is true follow this workflow. Needed when a record type has several primary workflows

startsWhen.description: Parallel only: the workflow starts when this becomes true on a save; when empty it starts on create

states.description: Where a record can be, in order

key.description: Stable name of the state, stored on the record

final.description: The work is finished; no steps lead out

locked.description: Records in this state cannot be edited, only transitioned

transitions.description: Steps people take to move a record from one state to another

key.description: Stable name of the step; part of its permission

from.description: States the step can start from

guardMessage.description: Shown when the expression is false

requiredFields.description: Fields that must be filled in before the step

approval.description: The step waits for approval by someone other than the requester

roles.description: People with these roles may approve

count.description: How many approvals are needed; default 1

when.description: Approval is needed only when this is true
